title: Nothing But Thieves
sub: Nothing But Thieves recorded a note to Stray Dogs. Ten seconds, 445 members, and exactly the mechanism LISA used in front of 162,165.
context: Nothing But Thieves to Stray Dogs — 445 members. The same mechanism a stadium act uses, at the other end of the scale.
claim:
The same thing a stadium act does.
On a channel of 445.
